FIELDS.DESCRIPTION OF OPERATIONS: At AutoTech Parts & Accessories, we specialize in the retail of high-quality automotive parts and accessories, serving both individual consumers and professional mechanics. Our operations include a well-organized inventory management system that ensures a wide range of products, from mechanical components to aftermarket accessories, are readily available. Our facility adheres to strict safety standards, including comprehensive fire protection measures, proper storage of materials, and compliance with OSHA regulations. Our team is trained to provide exceptional customer service, assisting customers with their inquiries and ensuring they find the right parts for their vehicles. As part of our commitment to quality, we continuously maintain our premises for security and safety, ensuring a conducive shopping environment.
